children: Blue Chip Capital Group Inc. reported a consolidated net loss of $(22.65M) for the fiscal year ended May 31, 2026, versus a loss of $(5.69M) in the prior year, while reporting no operating revenue in both years and diluted EPS of $(0.2354) for FY2026 compared with $(0.0687) in FY2025.
Revenue was $0 for FY ended May 31, 2026 and FY 2025 (no operating revenue reported since inception).
Net income: Consolidated net loss of $(22.65M) for FY ended May 31, 2026, worsening from $(5.69M) in FY 2025.
Diluted EPS: $(0.2354) for FY ended May 31, 2026, vs. $(0.0687) in FY 2025.
The company has not generated operating revenue since inception through May 31, 2026 and continues to rely on capital raises to fund operations.
Management is building Raisewise subsidiaries and launched Raisewise USA, a Reg C crowdfunding platform offering debt, equity, rewards and donations.
Increased reporting and compliance activity — including SEC filings, FINRA Form 211 and subsidiary regulatory filings — has driven higher professional engagement.
Despite limited cash, the company retained engineering, legal, accounting and consulting resources through private placements and related‑party advances.
Management plans additional private financings and pursuit of public post‑effective registration to expand the platform and sustain operations.
